description: This PHP source file renders the infrastructure for the Wi-Fi wizard step 2 page, including form handling, JavaScript validation, and dynamic content generation for configuring Wi-Fi settings such as SSID and security. It interacts with backend scripts to set and retrieve Wi-Fi configurations and manages user interactions for Wi-Fi setup.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends Wi-Fi configuration data via POST to the backend script to update network settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration string, and invokes set_config() to save the Wi-Fi settings.
